name: DataForSEO
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: pay-as-you-go SEO data APIs (SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, domain analytics, merchant and more).
access_notes: Free account signup issues API login/password immediately (API Access tab in dashboard); a small trial credit (~$1, about 500 SERP Live Advanced calls) is included, then pay-as-you-go top-ups from the Billing tab. Basic Authentication is the only auth method.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server (github.com/dataforseo/mcp-server-typescript, npm dataforseo-mcp-server, Docker dataforseo/mcp, plus vendor setup guide). Composio toolkit exists at composio.dev/toolkits/dataforseo with 312 tools.
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks=true refers to DataForSEO's task-completion pingback/postback URL mechanism in the task-based (non-live) endpoints; this is stated from general docs knowledge and was not re-verified on a fetched page this pass. API is broad in surface but predominantly data-retrieval (read).
